title: Will not close
text:
Will not close. I thought I finally found the black leather looking tissue holder I had been searching for. I loved it at first and was excited to put my tissue box in it and put it in our newly remodeled downstairs bathroom. Imagine my surprise when the bottom did not close properly! How is this possible??? Aren't all cubed tissue boxes the same?? Sent it back and purchased the Sumnacon Square Leather Tissue Box Cover in black. I had previously purchased the gray cloth version of this and it fits perfectly.

So buyer beware, does not fit properly!
